feature_contract.goal: Retain already-rendered native menu/vehicle/race full frames across successful live D3D9 partial Z and combined TARGET|Z Clears by verifying main depth owner and forwarding clipped rectangles to D3D11.1 ClearView on corresponding D32 DSV/RTV, without intercepting gamepad/FFB or breaking D3D9 Present fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Canonical partial Z Clear clips viewport rectangles and writes only the live native depth attachment while preserving game-authored Draw/DrawIndexed and untouched depth.
TARGET|Z bounded rectangles verify the exact native D32 attachment before any native color/depth change and forward both regions to ClearView without reseeding game frame.
Unsupported stencil, foreign main Z owner, MRT, invalid bounds, unavailable D3D11.1 or stopped native Draw preserve original D3D9 Clear, Present, gamepad and FFB; no partial native GPU mutation.
DX11 Fast, Backend Conversion, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD all conclude SUCCESS at the same final validation-bearing SHA; runtime HMD/game remains UNTESTED.

integration_path: Original game D3D9 Clear succeeds after live Draw/DrawIndexed and R9 hook carries flags/color/Z
Validate live backbuffer viewport, canonical D3D9 main Z identity, D32 native DSV, D3D11.1 context and entire clipped rectangle batch
Issue same-region D3D11.1 ClearView to native RTV and/or depth-only DSV and retain game source Draw ordinals through original Present
batch_components: D3D9 Clear hook forwards original Z with successful result to DX11 native bridge
DX11 depth owner/DSV/combined color-Z partial ClearView integration
Portable C++ positive/negative regression on partial depth and clipped region batches

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Existing material commit adds native_live_partial_depth_clear_regression and bounded D3D9 Z/combined color-Z to matching full-frame RTV/DSV.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Malformed/offscreen rectangles, mismatched canonical depth, missing context or D3D11.1, unsupported stencil/MRT must not partially mutate native frame; original D3D9 remains authoritative.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: Existing real game Draw/DrawIndexed -> native full-resolution frame -> game-authored Clear(Z or TARGET|Z) -> D3D11 ClearView RTV/DSV -> original D3D9 Present and input fallback.

development_strategy.visible_frame_acceptance: Full-resolution native source integration is code/CI scoped only; menu/vehicle/race visual and Quest3/VDXR/gamepad parity UNTESTED until actual game/HMD evidence.
development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: Existing diagnostic opt-in, no native automatic promotion; fail-closed for unsupported Z/stencil/MRT/context; original D3D9 Present/input/FFB/SkyGlow and DX9Ex fallback retained; DXVK frozen.
